cards.answer: Irelia is a fighter and assassin who chains dashes through marked or dying targets and builds attack speed through ability hits. Her physical dash scales with AD, while fully stacked basic attacks add magic damage.
cards.counterplay: Keep distance from weakened minions and avoid extended trades while her passive is fully stacked.

cards.answer: Ability hits grant stacking attack speed; at maximum stacks, basic attacks also deal bonus magic damage. Attacks against enemy champions refresh the stacks' duration.
cards.counterplay: Disengage while she is fully stacked and limit opportunities for her to keep attacking.

cards.answer: Bladesurge dashes through an enemy, dealing physical damage, applying on-hit effects and healing Irelia. Consuming a mark lets her dash again quickly; a target dying to or during the dash resets its cooldown.
cards.counterplay: Keep distance from weakened minions and play cautiously when marked.

cards.answer: Defiant Dance reduces incoming physical and magic damage while Irelia charges, and crowd control cannot interrupt the charge. The release deals physical damage around her and along a line, with damage increasing as she charges.
cards.counterplay: Hold burst damage until her damage reduction ends and move away from the release line.

cards.answer: Flawless Duet places blades that converge, dealing magic damage and stunning enemies along the line between them. Enemy champions hit are marked, enabling a quick Bladesurge reuse.
cards.counterplay: Move out of the line between the blades and give her space if marked.

cards.answer: Vanguard's Edge expands upon hitting an enemy champion, dealing magic damage and marking champions hit for Bladesurge reuse. It leaves a perimeter that damages and slows enemies crossing it; crossing the perimeter does not apply a mark.
cards.counterplay: Dodge the initial barrage and avoid crossing the blade perimeter when possible.
